city: San Fernando City, La Union, Philippines
selection_method: Editorial selection of established city care providers with identifiable official sources and published services. These entries are not ranked by revenue, clinical quality, investment return, or market demand.
investment_notice: No public equity, franchise, sale, or fundraising offer has been verified for these facilities. Contact each operator to ask whether an appropriate commercial partnership is available. Public facilities are care anchors, not private ownership investment listings.

featured.name: Lorma Medical Center
featured.address: Carlatan, San Fernando City, La Union 2500
featured.description: A private hospital whose published service directory includes rehabilitation, nutrition, and wellness care.
featured.investment_note: Ask hospital management about suitable service, referral, or supplier collaborations. No current ownership investment or franchise offer has been verified.
featured.evidence_note: The operator's contact and service pages support the displayed location and service types. Confirm present availability directly.

featured.name: Bethany Hospital, Inc.
featured.address: Widdoes Street, Brgy. II, San Fernando City, La Union 2500
featured.description: A city hospital with published wellness, rehabilitation, renal care, and diagnostic services.
featured.source_title: Bethany Hospital patient guide and address
featured.investment_note: Explore appropriate collaborations with hospital management. The operator discusses private partnerships in its mission, but no active capital-raising, sale, or franchise offer has been verified.
featured.evidence_note: Published services already include wellness and rehabilitation; their presence is not evidence of an unmet local service gap.

featured.evidence_note: The operator identifies Catbangen; the older local inventory identifies Tanqui. Use the operator address and withhold contradictory map coordinates pending verification.

featured.evidence_note: The 2026 institutional document supports its address. The dated Citizen's Charter supports listed service types, not a live appointment or capacity feed.

featured.name: DOH Treatment and Rehabilitation Center – La Union
featured.address: ITRMC Compound, Parian, San Fernando City, La Union 2500
featured.description: A Department of Health center publishing residential, outpatient, and aftercare pathways for substance use treatment.
featured.investment_note: This is a public treatment provider. Any collaboration must follow the center's requirements; it is not a private ownership investment listing.
featured.evidence_note: The official directory supports the location. Published treatment programs concern substance use; do not present the center as a general mental health clinic.

idea_sources.evidence_summary: Local hospitals already publish rehabilitation services. A community studio could be explored through operator interviews and a referral plan; unmet demand has not been established.
idea_sources.source_title: Lorma hospital services: physical therapy and rehabilitation

idea_sources.evidence_summary: ITRMC publishes nutrition counseling and meal-plan services. A qualified dietitian-led complementary concept needs customer research and coordination with existing providers.
idea_sources.source_title: ITRMC 2025 Citizen's Charter: nutrition and diet services

idea_sources.evidence_summary: DOH-TRC publishes substance use treatment and aftercare programs. Any complementary support concept needs qualified professionals, a defined scope, and a confirmed referral arrangement.
idea_sources.source_title: DOH-TRC La Union 2026 Citizen's Charter: outpatient and aftercare programs

idea_sources.evidence_summary: Bethany describes mobility, gait, balance, and strength work within its rehabilitation services. A separate movement studio would need safe access, qualified supervision, and locally validated demand.
idea_sources.source_title: Bethany Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Unit

idea_sources.evidence_summary: Bethany already publishes a Metabolic and Wellness Center. A preventive practice should be researched as complementary service capacity rather than an assumed missing facility.
idea_sources.source_title: Bethany published services: Metabolic and Wellness Center

idea_sources.evidence_summary: Bethany's patient guide discusses rooms, visiting arrangements, and companion rules. A caregiver respite concept is an inference to investigate with families and operators, not a documented shortage.
idea_sources.source_title: Bethany Hospital patient and companion guide
